name: tradecanvas
description: Trading charts for the web, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL: 111 indicators, 69 drawing tools, 18 chart types, live exchange feeds, orders on the chart, replay and backtesting. Zero dependencies. TypeScript, React, Vue, Svelte.

paragraphs: Live demo · Docs · Examples · Playground · Changelog

A complete trading chart for the web. Candlesticks to Renko, 111 indicators, 69 drawing tools, live exchange feeds and orders on the chart, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL, with zero dependencies. Drop in the full ChartWidget, or build your own UI on the headless Chart, in plain TypeScript, React, Vue or Svelte.
features: 111 built-in indicators — SMA, EMA, TEMA, VWMA, Hull MA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, Envelope, Ichimoku, Pivot Points, Anchored VWAP, ZigZag, Linear Regression Channel, Awesome / Chaikin Oscillator, and more. Any indicator…

69 drawing tools — Trendlines (info line, trend angle, cross line), Fibonacci (retracement, extension, channel, time zones, speed resistance fan and arcs, circles, spiral, wedge), horizontal/vertical lines, channels,…

18 chart types — Candlestick, line, area, bar, hollow candle, baseline, High-Low, Heikin-Ashi, Renko, Kagi, Line Break, Point & Figure, Range Bars, Volume Candles, Equivolume, HLC Area, Step Line, Line+Markers. Renko's…

Pro-grade interaction — pan freely past the last bar into empty future space (drawings can go there too), drag the price/time axes to scale, double-click to auto-fit, Ctrl/⌘+drag to select several drawings (then move,…

Trading overlay — Render open positions with entry line, P&L zone, and SL/TP markers. Orders as dashed lines. Drag SL/TP to modify, cancel / close / reverse from the buttons on each line, and see every fill marked on…
